title.purpose: Place name, led by the condition emoji.

body.purpose: Base text, buttons and the search input.

detail.purpose: Condition, wind, updated and location rows.

label.purpose: Subtitle line under the title; 'Feels like' lines use the same size.

shadows.name: card-float
shadows.purpose: The card, the only lifted surface.

shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft glow under the primary button.

motion.name: control-ease
motion.purpose: Border-color and shadow transitions on buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action per screen (Refresh).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(37,99,235,.16); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .02s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(37,99,235,.24); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.16); border-color: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions such as Search submit and Retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .02s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9ca3af; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.16); border-color: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Lightweight toggles and alternatives: Search / Hide search, Use my location.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #2563eb; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.16); }

components.name: City Search
components.description: Text field plus submit, used when geolocation is unavailable or toggled on.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" onsubmit="return false"><input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Enter city (e.g., Paris)" aria-label="City name"><button class="ds-search-btn" type="submit">Search</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; } .ds-input, .ds-search-btn { font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 10px 12px; background: #fff; color: #111827; } .ds-search-btn { cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible, .ds-search-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.16); border-color: #2563eb; }

components.name: Twin Dials
components.description: The signature pair of equal temperature readings, °F and °C.
components.html:
68°F
Feels like 66°F
20°C
Feels like 19°C
components.css: .ds-dials { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111827; } .ds-dial { display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; min-height: 120px; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px dashed #e5e7eb; } .ds-reading { font-size: clamp(40px, 8vw, 64px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.5px; } .ds-unit { font-size: .45em; color: #6b7280; margin-left: .2ch; } .ds-feels { color: #6b7280; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Weather Card
components.description: The single lifted container that holds the whole page.
components.html:
☀️ New York, NY
Clear sky • Updated just now
components.css: .ds-card { width: min(92vw, 680px); background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08); padding: 20px 20px 16px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111827; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .2px; } .ds-card-sub { color: #6b7280; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Panel
components.description: Fills the dials' place while loading, on error, or before a location is chosen.
components.html: Fetching current weather…
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 18px; min-height: 120px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #eee; color: #374151; font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-spinner { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2.5px solid #e5e7eb; border-top-color: #2563eb; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin 1s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spinner { animation-duration: 3s; } }

narrative.overview:
The whole page is built around two equal readings, °F and °C, sitting side by side like a pair of gauges on one instrument. Everything else is in service of those two numbers: a small title row naming the place, a short line of details underneath, and controls tucked into the corner.

The feel is friendly and light. One white card floats on a soft gray field, corners are gently rounded, and a single weather emoji gives the page its warmth. Type is the visitor's own system font, so the page feels native on every device. Density is low: one card, one glance.

Signal Blue is the one voice of action. It marks what can be pressed and where keyboard focus is, and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Two identical temperature dials of equal weight; neither unit leads.
A single centered white card on a pale gray gradient field.
System font stack throughout; weight and size carry hierarchy, not typefaces.
One accent color, reserved for interaction.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears only on things you can press and on focus. Text, numbers, borders and decoration never use it.

rules.name: The Readings Are Loudest Rule
rules.body: Only the two temperatures use the Display size. Nothing else on the card is allowed to compete with them.

rules.name: The Side-by-Side Rule
rules.body: The °F and °C dials always share a row at equal width. They never stack, and they never resize independently.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the card casts a shadow. Interior panels use borders or tint, never their own shadow.

dos: Do keep °F and °C as two identical dials of equal size, weight and color.
Do reserve Signal Blue (#2563eb) for pressable things and focus, per the One Signal Rule.
Do use the system font stack and express hierarchy through size and weight.
Do keep radius growing with container size: 10px controls, 12px panels, 16px card.
Do show focus with the 3px Signal Ring outline on every interactive element.
donts: Don't make one unit primary: no toggle, and no larger or brighter reading for either unit.
Don't add shadows to anything inside the card.
Don't use the Display size for anything except the two temperature readings.
Don't introduce a second accent color for decoration.
